notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/488bc523b61c71dc11234a4a582dd6a077a10e9f.png[/img][h2]📰 Update Time![/h2]
Greetings Mubs, [b]you're reading the latest news about Minigame Madness V0.15.6[/b]! This bi-weekly update we've finished Royal Rumble, added webscreen requests & more! 🤩

⚠️ [i]Check the changelog at the bottom of this post for the full list of changes![/i]

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]🏳️ Summit Scramble[/h3]
Summit Scramble flags[b] are now colored in your Mub's color[/b], instead of 🏳️!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/17bf3057195c451ca80aeb834cc67a7035b6705c.png[/img]
yeah idk i just like how it looks ngl tbh 🤸

[h3]👑 Royal Rumble[/h3]
[b]Royal Rumble is finally complete![/b] Check out the brand-new thumbnail! 🤩
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/3498e981f085b92fbe7ae83f3d0d8e368493d98f.png[/img]
I could write at length about[b] all the polishing[/b] we've done to get it to this state, BUT it might be best to let the polishing speak for itself. Have fun claiming that crown in possibly the nicest looking map yet! 👑💫

With Royal Rumble finished,[b] we can now finally start development on the highly anticipated Manic Murderer![/b] 🔪😱

[h2]🏠 Condo Changes[/h2]
[h3]📺 Webscreen Video Requests[/h3]
Previously, visitors in your Condo had to manually type video titles into chat to suggest them to the host. That made watching videos and listening to music with friends feel less seamless than it should be. 😑

Suggesting videos has now been made effortless: [b]visitors can now just click a video in the browser, and it will appear in chat as a clickable link for the host![/b] 🤩
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/183c64af262280ccb47ad295e594284f553c02af.png[/img]

[b]Played videos are now broadcasted as links in the chat[/b], making the chat a reversible watch history! 🧠
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/7e86d758828e1c89c42274682f94a8d4db621774.png[/img]

Build a cozy Condo, grab some popcorn, and have fun watching YouTube together! 🍿🎥

[h2]🎥 Showcase[/h2]
[h3]🤖 Bot Updates[/h3]
[b]Bot development has been in full force[/b], and we hope to now be able to showcase something every update until they finally get released! This time: [b]Sumo Shamble bots![/b] (WIP) 🏝️
[previewyoutube=XqIRncjfX_c;full][/previewyoutube]The island bots still need some more training staying dry, but it's already real fun fighting with 'em! 🥊💫

[h2]🔔 Stay Tuned[/h2]
[b]Stay tuned to the ever-expanding Minigame Madness experience[/b] by following us on Steam and [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]joining the Discord community[/url]! Spread the word about Minigame Madness by leaving a review! 📢

Have an epic day, or an average one! No pressure. 👋🏼

[url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/34fc72651c5981ce01214364d90b8d2e73831a1f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Minigame Madness V0.15.5 is out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/a45798e1a3f163fbe103bc3c0eacba4fcdcc8e7e.png[/img][h2]📰 Update Time![/h2]
Greetings Mubs, [b]you're reading the latest news about Minigame Madness V0.15.5[/b]! This bi-weekly update we've overhauled Royal Rumble, added an active tutorial, updated key art & more! 🤩

⚠️ [i]Check the changelog at the bottom of this post for the full list of changes![/i]

[h2]⭐ General Changes[/h2]
[h3]🌈 New Capsule Art[/h3]
With the Steam store becoming wider in the near future, we can now afford to put more detail into our capsule, and thus we wanted to utilize it to the best of our ability! 

[b]Check out our new store capsule![/b] 🤩
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/faab29b04a9dc39e45d96a0107a62c5d53954cf9.gif[/img]
We think it feels a lot more "premium" than our previous capsule. Let us know what you think! 👂

[h3]🧐 Active Tutorial[/h3]
While this might not sound like the flashiest feature for existing players, it will be exciting for them too, because it means more… new blood. 😂

[b]The new active tutorial helps guide newcomers through the game[/b], addressing common points we’ve seen players get stuck at. For instance, around 10% of new players never even make it into the elevator, either because they can’t find it, or because they don’t realize they need to press S to leave the shop and thus get stuck shopping forever!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/8eb90553accc14e14fa12d1a1b080d235e54f6e9.png[/img]
We’ve also noticed many new players struggle with things like voting, expanding their Condo, or even chatting. 😅

This new tutorial replaces the old message-box style one, and don’t worry, you can turn it off anytime in the interface settings if you’re a pro already! 🤓

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]👑 Royal Rumble[/h3]
Royal Rumble's gameplay is fully dependent on the map, so any map changes are, in fact, also gameplay changes!

That said, [b]Royal Rumble's map has been completely overhauled[/b], going for a thinner but more vertical layout, similar to the battle-tested Explosive Exchange map! 🤩🏰
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/2e5f69701842cfa7cdd9791d0babbc168bde6b51.png[/img]⚠️ [i]Still WIP, but we're nearing finalization on Royal Rumble![/i] 🙌

[b]There are at least 10 pixel-perfect parkour jumps in the map[/b], allowing skilled players to get away from the crowd that's chasing the crown! 🤴

We're looking forward to play testing this map with you all! 😄

[h2]🔔 Stay Tuned[/h2]
[b]Stay tuned to the ever-expanding Minigame Madness experience[/b] by following us on Steam and [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]joining the Discord community[/url]! Spread the word about Minigame Madness by leaving a review! 📢

Have an epic day, or an average one! No pressure. 👋🏼

[url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/34fc72651c5981ce01214364d90b8d2e73831a1f.png[/img][/url]

[h3]V0.15.5[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a gate, well, grass, towers, a table, chairs, more torches, more barrels and scaffolding to Royal Rumble map
[*]Added active tutorial to the HUD, helping new players every step along the way
[*]Added interface setting to hide tutorial

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/80d3a04a6d72f99a240538d1b83381120e5b4b20.png[/img][h2]📰 Update Time![/h2]
Greetings Mubs, [b]you're reading the latest news about Minigame Madness V0.15.4[/b]! This bi-weekly update we've got vote results, new leaderboards, video suggestions & more! 🤩

⚠️ [i]Check the changelog at the bottom of this post for the full list of changes![/i]

[h2]🗳️ Minigame Poll Results![/h2]
[b]Our 6th official minigame poll has come to a close![/b] Let's see the results!
(Read about the minigames in detail in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1408080/view/520847189963965167]previous post[/url].)

🥉 In [b]third place[/b], 💥 [b]Wreckage Wrangle[/b] ⛏️ with 27.3% of the votes! 
🥈 In [b]second place[/b], 🎨 [b]Color Calamity[/b] 🪣 with 31.8% of the votes!
🥇 And in [b]FIRST PLACE[/b], 🔪 [b]Manic Murderer[/b] 😨 with 40.9% of the votes!

[b]Congratulations to everyone who voted for Manic Murderer! 🥳🥳🥳 [/b]
Manic Murderer will be added in our next development cycle!

If you want to participate whenever the next minigame poll happens, [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]join the Discord[/url]! ❤️

[h2]🛸 Hub Changes[/h2]
[h3]📊 Leaderboards[/h3]
This update,[b] we've added 15 new leaderboards to the Hub[/b]! A dedicated XP leaderboard for each minigame! 🤯
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/c1d5ce64efed223b240f4b1e67f736beca5aa387.png[/img]These leaderboards are unique in that they reward players for mainlining a single minigame, so if you're addicted to a specific minigame, let the addiction consume you! 🤩🌈

They also finally give a purpose to the listing of minigame XP on your profile! 🧐

These new boards will also help combat the calcification of leaderboards, considering every so often a brand new minigame will be added alongside a completely new leaderboard to compete in, making it easier for everyone to participate! 📊

To make participation even more accessible,[b] you can now walk up to any leaderboard, and the chat will tell you your EXACT position on it[/b], even if you're not in the top #10! 😯
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/d9c829ca019a1ad5074abdf3522d7f7874bf9f79.png[/img]

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]☠️ Death Prediction[/h3]
Woah what a title. I promise it's not that intense, but it IS pretty cool for the wifi players. 🛜

[b]In minigames where death is very easy to predict[/b], such as 💥 Blazing Bullets, ☁️ Freefall Frenzy and ☢️ Parkour Panic, [b]dying will now have 0 latency, no matter your ping![/b]

No longer will your body slightly clip into the giant blazing bullets, [b]it now feels just as responsive and "punchy" as in singleplayer![/b] 💥

[h3]☁️ Freefall Frenzy[/h3]
[b]Freefall Frenzy has gotten a new level called "Square"[/b], which nicely scales with gradual difficulty so you can encounter it at any moment in the game, increasing gameplay variety considering it's uniquely designed to make you hit the map boundaries! ⚙️

[b]Freefall Frenzy also has finally gotten ping compensation[/b], making the gameplay feel exactly the same whether you're the host, or a client with 300 ping! 🛜

[h2]🏠 Condo Changes[/h2]
[h3]📺 Webscreen Suggestions[/h3]
Wanna chill in your Condo with friends, but don't know what to watch? Relatable! 😅

For this reason, [b]the webscreen search results will now initially be populated with trending videos, and - upon clicking any video - will show suggestions based on that video![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/1495d20f6477a22f2c539f8a60207ce56f450c66.png[/img]
Not sponsored by MrBeast lol, he just tends to appear on trending... a lot 😂

[h3]🔥 Torches[/h3]
Imported straight from the cold Crumble Crisis mountains, [b]Torches are a new Condo furniture[/b], making your Condo cozier than ever before! 😌🔥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/70a1e085bc9d897ee4d3f27a619dc6d38a02f851.png[/img]Get Torches today by getting lucky while opening a furniture crate! 🍀📦

[h2]🔔 Stay Tuned[/h2]
[b]Stay tuned to the ever-expanding Minigame Madness experience[/b] by following us on Steam and [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]joining the Discord community[/url]! Spread the word about Minigame Madness by leaving a review! 📢

Have an epic day, or an average one! No pressure. 👋🏼

[url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/34fc72651c5981ce01214364d90b8d2e73831a1f.png[/img][/url]

[h3]V0.15.4[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added 15 new leaderboards to the Hub: a dedicated XP leaderboard for each minigame
[*]Added a chat notification when walking up to a Hub leaderboard telling you your exact position on the board
[*]Added Freefall Frenzy level "Square"
[*]Added "Torch" furniture

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/1e8a96b3d92b53ca2f868c50cb85b0c2ee2290a6.png[/img][h2]📰 Update Time![/h2]
Greetings Mubs, [b]you're reading the latest news about Minigame Madness V0.15.3[/b]! This bi-weekly update we have an official minigame vote, a quick-chat system, Royal and Freefall updates & more! 🤩

⚠️ [i]Check the changelog at the bottom of this post for the full list of changes![/i]

[h2]🗳️ The Official Minigame Vote![/h2]
With both ☁️ Freefall Frenzy and 👑 Royal Rumble nearing finalization, [b]it's about time we look ahead at the future, and you can help us shape it![/b] 🤠

[b]Our next development cycle will focus on the winner of this poll![/b] Choose wisely:

[h3]OPTION A: Color Calamity 🎨🪣[/h3]
[b]Color Calamity is turf war![/b] Players cover paint on all surfaces they touch, in the color of their Mub. Be the player with the most paint on the map at the end to win!

[h3]OPTION B: Manic Murderer 🔪😨[/h3]
[b]Manic Murderer is sus! [/b]One player is the murderer, another is sheriff, the rest are innocents. The murderer needs to (secretly) kill everyone to win, while the innocents & sheriff need to kill or outlast the murderer to win!

[h3]OPTION C: Wreckage Wrangle 💥⛏️[/h3]
[b]Wreckage Wrangle is destruction derby![/b] All players compete to destroy as much as possible of a sacred temple. The player with the most destruction wins!

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/pE5djCy7jf]Join the Discord server and check the #polls channel to cast your vote![/url][/h3]
⚠️ [i]Poll will close in 2 weeks![/i]

[h2]⭐ General Changes[/h2]
[h3]🗣️ Quick-Chat System[/h3]
Recently Minigame Madness has started gaining some traction in China and Brazil, which we're super excited about! 🌐

To help make our game more accessible to this growing global audience, [b]we've added a quick-chat system[/b]. [b]Quick-chats automatically get translated[/b] on the end-user's screen, allowing everyone to share their thoughts no matter their nationality! 🗣️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/097b0a33bf76d4da747d658b843a8e74e8d21acc.png[/img]
Besides globalization, [b]quick-chats also finally allow gamepad users to easily communicate![/b] 🎮

On top of that, [b]users can choose to ONLY be able to see quick-chats[/b] inside the safety settings, making the chat completely safe while still allowing for fun communication! 🛡️

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]☁️ Freefall Frenzy[/h3]
Freefall Frenzy has gained [b]two new animated end-game levels called "Wiper" & "Splitter".[/b] ☠️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/06e4c3e34d77cf8ef20149328bb8654f72303690.gif[/img]
If they look easy, they aren't! Be prepared to learn by dying! Luckily they only show up very late! 👼

[h3]👑 Royal Rumble[/h3]
[b]The castle map has been updated a bunch.[/b] Check it out! 🏰
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/66d2796ec2f8475e156240ab82a8a690e6b9f506.png[/img]
Still very WIP though! ⚠️

Besides map upgrades, [b]we've also added ping compensation to the stealing of crowns[/b], hopefully making it more fun for high-ping individuals! 🛜

[h2]🔔 Stay Tuned[/h2]
[b]Stay tuned to the ever-expanding Minigame Madness experience[/b] by following us on Steam and [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]joining the Discord community[/url]! Spread the word about Minigame Madness by leaving a review! 📢

Have an epic day, or an average one! No pressure. 👋🏼

[url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/34fc72651c5981ce01214364d90b8d2e73831a1f.png[/img][/url]

[h3]V0.15.3[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added quick-chat system, allowing gamepad users and people of different nationalities to communicate!
[*]Added new safety setting to only show quick chats (and thus hide custom chats)
[*]Added 2 new Freefall Frenzy end-game levels called "Wiper" & "Splitter"
[*]Added stairs, stables, barrels & torches to the Royal Rumble map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/ddd0f3d3e2abaf1d6f0a7c5058cd280807933f11.png[/img][h2]📰 Update Time![/h2]Greetings Mubs, [b]you're reading the latest news about Minigame Madness V0.15.2[/b]! This bi-weekly update we've added private settings, new Freefall Frenzy levels & more! 🤩 

⚠️ [i]Check the changelog at the bottom of this post for the full list of changes![/i]

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]⚙️ Private Minigame Settings[/h3]
[b]We've introduced private settings [/b]to give you more control when hosting a private minigame server. Tailor the experience to your group's play style! ⚙️

Need a quick break without leaving your private server? [b]Hosts can now pause the server[/b], which goes into effect during the next minigame's intro! ⏸️

Got some less experienced friends who keep dying in seconds, but you wanna keep going for up to 120 seconds?[b] Enable "Continue Solo" to keep playing even after everyone else is out![/b] 🧠
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/dbc8fc4b8e445acb07c211cfbc2eed9730a4e332.png[/img]

[h3]🧠 Twisted Trivia[/h3]
Due to the varying nature of outfits, the outfit question type was always either too easy (Which outfit is named "Doctor"?), or impossible (Which outfit is named "Skrunkle"?). To fix this, [b]we've internally given each outfit a difficulty score, so that over time the question can scale in difficulty.[/b] No more insta-deaths on the second question! 😂

[b]We've also made the map's oranges more yellow[/b], to make Twisted Trivia's color profile more visually distinct from Chaotic Chambers' color profile. 👁️

[h3]☁️ Freefall Frenzy[/h3]
After more than 2 months, it's finally time to continue development on Freefall Frenzy! 🛠️

[b]5 new floor types have been added to the minigame, including animated ones! [/b]⚙️😵‍💫
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/f385b7d23f7de5e2b5390d75185bb7b9ab71369c.gif[/img]
We've also improved the level generator and polished the experience, making the game more difficult in a fun way! 💪

[h2]👀 Teaser Time![/h2]
[b]We've internally been training neural bots[/b] for Disco Disorder (the hardest game to train for), here's how they're doing so far! 🤖
[previewyoutube=8gcspeqtjEc;full][/previewyoutube]

Have an epic day, or an average one! No pressure. 👋🏼

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/34fc72651c5981ce01214364d90b8d2e73831a1f.png"][/img]

[h3]V0.15.2[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Freefall Frenzy levels "Grid", "Blinds", "Spinner", "Spinner Gap" and "Pipes"
[*]Added "Pause" toggle for private minigame servers to pause the games

[b]Our 5th official minigame poll has come to a close![/b] Let's see the results!
(Read about the minigames in detail in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1408080/announcements/detail/645814564414293030]previous post[/url].)

🥉 In [b]third place[/b], 🏃 [b]Rotten Rampage[/b] 🧟 with 11.8% of the votes! 
🥈 In [b]second place[/b], 💥 [b]Wreckage Wrangle [/b] ⛏️ with 41.2% of the votes!
🥇 And in [b]FIRST PLACE[/b], 👑 [b]Royal Rumble[/b] 🏰 with 47.1% of the votes!

[b]Congratulations to everyone who voted for Royal Rumble! 🥳🥳🥳 [/b]
Royal Rumble will be added in our next development cycle!

If you want to participate whenever the next minigame poll happens, [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]join the Discord[/url]! ❤️

[h2]⭐ General Changes[/h2]
[h3]🎥 (WIP) Replay System[/h3]
[b]We've added a (work-in-progress) replay system[/b] to allow you to re-experience your best moments, whether in minigames or condos!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/c9f6a66bc245a027b57a1616a78e5f1cb2d1811a.png[/img]
[b]Replays can be started and stopped by pressing F9, and they can then be watched inside your condo[/b], by checking the 'Replays' tab inside the 'Extras' tab! 🍿🎞️

Replays are great for content creators, for "normal people" to share with friends, and for us devs to analyze games, because [b]it's not a static video - you get to move the camera around like in spectator mode[/b]! 📹

⚠️ [i]There's a lot of work left to do on replays. For example, replays don't work well yet in most minigames. Next update we'll hopefully have patched every minigame to fix this. Until then, Blazing Bullets and Condo replays seem to work quite flawlessly![/i]

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]☢️ Parkour Panic[/h3]
Parkour Panic has historically been the minigame that's both the toughest for noobs, and the easiest for pros. Noobs (literally) die as soon as humanly possible, and pros consistently reach the roof - both of which should be impossible! 🤯

How do you make a game harder for pros, while easier for noobs at the same time? Well, [b]today we present yet another attempt at solving the balancing nightmare that is Parkour Panic![/b] 🧐

To make the game harder for pros, [b]booster pads are now disabled when high above the acid[/b]. This makes the game relatively easier for noobs, as they are usually closer to the acid. On top of that, it also makes the game more intense for pros, who have been craving more challenge. 💪

To make the game even more easier for noobs, [b]we've increased the platform count by ~15%[/b]. This will both make platform paths easier to spot, while also allowing noobs to easier find footing when falling from heights - hopefully reducing their death rate. Considering pros already have no trouble finding paths and generally don't fall, they shouldn't be buffed by this. 😅

We also fixed a rare gamebreaking issue where no platform spawned on a layer whatsoever! 🪲

Will Parkour Panic finally be balanced? We'll find out by analyzing the data throughout this month. 🧠

[h3]🧊 Crumble Crisis[/h3]
[b]Crumble Crisis has been rebalanced in many ways, ultimately making the game easier again for beginners[/b]. That said, we'll be balancing the game in multiplayer LIVE today during the dev session in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]Discord[/url]. 🥶

[h3]⚽️ Football Fever[/h3]
Balancing is an ever-evolving action, as it depends on the playerbase as much as the minigame itself. Metas and strategies are constantly evolving, and we've noticed players getting too good at being goalkeepers/camping their goals, leading some matches to be concluded in boring ties! 🥱

For this reason, [b]goals now become 10% larger towards the end of the game[/b]. 🏃‍➡️⚽🥅

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]🧊 Crumble Crisis[/h3]
[b]Crumble Crisis has finally been made solo-able[/b], as promised! The style we're going for with Crumble Crisis is the classic snake game, and that one is solo-able too! However, unlike in the classic snake game, you can jump in this one, leading to weird strategies.

[b]We've nerfed a cheesy jumpy strategy somewhat[/b] and rewritten the crumbling mechanics from the ground up to allow for this, but we still have a long way to go in terms of balancing! 🧀

[b]We've also made the crumbled ice easier to see visually[/b], along with many other polishing changes! 🧊

[h2]🏠 Condo Changes[/h2]
[h3]🤖 Androids[/h3]
Got no friends? Me neither! Which is why we've added a way to make your Condo more lively! ✨

[b]Androids are a new Condo "furniture" that comes alive, just like the NPCs in the Hub![/b] They take on the appearance of your Mub at spawn, just like Mannequins, except these brethren will navigate around and talk to each other within the confines of your Condo! 💬
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/6c55ff526a59bc7e4e0ca745fbb5c2a2ed2dd889.png[/img]
[b]Androids can even be made huge or tiny like all other furniture[/b], allowing you to make a cute pet or even a menacing giant! 👹

Get Androids today by buying the ensemble, or get lucky opening a furniture crate! 🍀📦

[h3]🎨 Paint Hotkey (& Donation Mechanic)[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1408080/view/520835774959059786]Last week[/url] we added the Condo furniture painting mechanic, allowing players to spawn colored furniture from their inventory, but we hadn't yet added an ability for players to paint existing furniture. Today we rectify that! ✅

[b]By pressing the 'Color' hotkey ('C' by default), you can now color already-placed furniture with your currently equipped color,[/b] making it easier than ever to paint your existing Condo! 🌈

However, a critical reader would ask, "[i]How would that work with color ownership? What if a visitor has a color that the host doesn't?[/i]" 🤔

For this reason [b]we've added the "visitor color donation" mechanic[/b], allowing visitors to paint with whatever color they own, even if the Condo owner doesn't have it. This allows friendgroups to grind certain items collectively for a single Condo, for the first time. Teamwork! 🤩

[h3]📺 Webscreen Rework[/h3]
Webscreen-enabled furniture has always had an inconsistent way of interacting, where it required a clumsy aim-click unlike any other furniture interaction. We've been wanting to adjust this for a long time, but didn't get around to it until now. 🤔

[b]The webscreen video selector has now been merged into the [ESC]>Settings>Condo tab,[/b] which can now be instantly accessed within a Condo by pressing the 'Options' hotkey ('O' by default). 📺
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/6aab383a43bf261d4682cf22dc7d979c46381a6f.png[/img]

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]🧊 Crumble Crisis[/h3]
The Crumble Crisis map was designed back in 2020 before we had size-standards. [b]We've now shrunk the map[/b] to match the other maps:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/41f037e6120061b31dc2aa919e1263878156090c.gif[/img]
Keeping the crumbling mechanics the same (permanently crumbled) would be problematic at this size: a single player would crumble the entire map in 20 seconds, let alone 16 players! This is why [b]we changed the ice to slowly come back up, creating a "tail" of crumbled ice[/b] that follows all players, similar to the classic game Snake! 🐍

[b]This "tail" of ice increases in length over time[/b], therefore dynamically increasing the difficulty of the minigame over time, as is the norm in our games. 🫡

This implementation paves the way for Crumble Crisis to become solo-able, just like the classic Snake game is singleplayer well. We still have a LOT of balancing left to do, so for now it remains multiplayer though! 🧐

[h3]⚽️ Football Fever[/h3]
The kick-offs in Football Fever often felt buggy due to players from all sides walking into the ball at the EXACT same time, causing the ball to get stuck in the middle of everyone. To help prevent this, [b]we now shoot the ball into the air at the start of the game[/b], adding a layer of skill to the kick-offs and decreasing the amount of collisions at the start, therefore hopefully reducing weirdness at the start of matches! ⚽

[h2]🏠 Condo Changes[/h2]
[h3]🌈 Furniture Painting[/h3]
To help you make your Condo feel uniquely yours, [b]we've finally added the ability to paint furniture![/b] In the furniture inventory you can now select a color, just like you would when selecting a color for clothes! 🤩🎨

Lights can be colored by painting their secondary color, and if you make the secondary color black, it will turn the lamp off! 💡

Vending Machines and Presents both give gadgets to players upon walking into them, and these gadgets will also be colored accordingly to the paint. 🎉

There's so much more to talk about, but we'll let you experiment with it on your own, have fun! 🌈

[h3]⚽️ Football Fever[/h3]
Football Fever, our most popular minigame to date, has finally been [b]FINISHED[/b]! 🥳⚽

🤩 [b]Visuals[/b]
[b]We've improved the overall visuals of the minigame everywhere[/b], most noticeably: we changed the overwhelming puke-green color to something more appealing to the eye, take a look at the thumbnail! 🤩
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/08a0f0bd4d9b1e253149bda1a3f017664dee6c04.png[/img]We've also added [b]a)[/b] black dots to the ball for some much needed contrast, [b]b)[/b] screenshakes for extra impact everywhere, [b]c)[/b] active ragdolling upon getting hit hard by the ball, [b]d) [/b]better ambience sound for improved immersion, [b]e)[/b] a juicy goal crumbling sound effect, [b]f)[/b] a dope spectator camera welded to the ball, [b]g)[/b] etc, ETC, [b]ETC[/b]! 🥴💫

🛠️ [b]Ball physics[/b]
The ping-compensated ball physics from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1408080/view/499439875179677987]last bi-week's update[/url] were an improvement for high-ping players, but a downgrade for low-ping players. Ultimately, when doing ping-compensation there's always a trade-off of some kind, but it was way too rough for low-ping players. So, [b]we've made many improvements to the ball physics[/b] to help smooth out the experience! 🧐

We believe that today's update is a big step in the right direction, but despite being considered finished, [b]the football physics are something we'll continue to improve over time[/b], over many playtests! 💪🥸

[h2]🏠 Condo Changes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/170646eea9b3842994b1109a3ae3662120600122.png[/img]Store your memories permanently as pictures in your Condo! 📸

[b]How to do this?[/b] Just take a screenshot (F12) in-game at any time (even in minigames), and then spawn a Picture Frame in your Condo at a later moment in the same session! Capture your best minigame wins! 🙀

Also: [b]modders, you know what to do![/b] ⚙️ ([i]%localappdata%\MinigameMadness\Saved\TempCameraRoll[/i])

[h2]🕹️ Minigame Changes[/h2]
[h3]🧠 Twisted Trivia[/h3]

[h3]🏳️ Summit Scramble[/h3]
Summit Scramble's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1408080/view/6401387156588348253]recent flag overhaul[/url] [b]has been received well[/b], and the minigame has risen on the popularity leaderboard because of it: 🤩📈
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/0e4791083212bc9b11dc08377a5923b63d06e92a.png[/img]That said, it severely needed more balancing, so [b]we've added a short grace period before dropping the flag[/b]. We've also slightly reduced movement speed up the stairs and reduced flag holder knockback even further at big playercounts for some extra me-time for the king on top. 🫶

We hope both of these changes will help our kings to claim a pyramid for longer periods of time, leading to an overall more structured battle. 👑

[h2]🏠 Condo Changes[/h2]
[h3]🎉 Vending Machines & Confetti Poppers[/h3]

[h2]Summit Scramble Overhaul[/h2]
Summit Scramble never felt much like a king-of-the-hill, but more like a KINGS-of-the-hill. With everyone constantly at the top fighting, no clear winner ever came out on top. After this structureless battle, it often felt like a seemingly random player was chosen as winner. 🤔

Summit Scramble clearly needed some more structure, so [b]we completely overhauled it[/b]! 🙌

[h2]Bi-Weekly Update![/h2]
Our very first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1408080/view/4109043267626690546]minigame vote[/url] has FINISHED! [b]Keep reading to find out which minigame won![/b] 🤞😳

Check the changelog at the bottom of this post for the full list of changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/f8262370b5ff63ad15321c35e7e6e176be089157.png[/img]
[i]Credit: @JaZed, @CaeTheCow, @Blammo, @WizzDude, @Enrico[/i]

[h2]THE FIRST MINIGAME VOTE RESULTS![/h2]
Our very first minigame vote has come to a close! [b]Let's see the results![/b] (Read about the minigames in detail in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1408080/view/4109043267626690546]previous post[/url].)

🥉 At the [b]third place[/b], we have 👑 [b]Royal Rumble[/b] 👑 with 8.3% of the votes! 

🥈 At the [b]second place[/b], we have 🥶 [b]Crumble Crisis[/b] 🥶 which got exactly 25% of the votes!

🥇 And at the [b]FIRST PLACE[/b], we have ☢️ [b]Parkour Panic[/b] ☢️ with 66,7% (2/3!) of the votes!

[b]Congratulations to everyone who voted for Parkour Panic! 🥳🥳🥳[/b]

It's been so exciting to involve the community in shaping our game in such a big way, and we plan to continue to do this more often. If you want to participate whenever the next minigame vote happens, [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]join the Minigame Madness Discord[/url]! ❤️

Now onto the next segment:

[h2]NEW MINIGAME RELEASE ALERT[/h2]
As seen in the previous segment, Parkour Panic won the first minigame vote, becoming our 10th minigame! [b]Although we initially never planned to add the winning minigame right away, we decided to surprise you all[/b] when we discovered that the votes stabilized over Parkour Panic very early on! 🤩🫡

V0.6 includes our [b]BRAND NEW solo-able WIP minigame called Parkour Panic! ☢️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/96a0639827438572f3bc63157d89c2cb7cd68c07.png[/img]
We want to add as many different types of games to Minigame Madness as possible, and Parkour Panic stands out as [b]our very first TRUE parkour game[/b]! Acid will slowly rise inside a hexagonal container, jump up on randomly generated parkour pieces to avoid dissolving in acid! 🤢

Parkour Panic has lots of playstyles, from slow-and-steady to high-risk-high-reward and more, we can't wait to see you guys compete against each other! 🤩

As with all WIP minigames, [b]Parkour Panic is very early in development[/b] and will receive big improvements and changes over the coming weeks, yet players have already told us they're enjoying it big time! 😄 

[h2]Improved Robot Ruckus[/h2]
As you may have noticed, we haven't finalized production on Robot Ruckus yet, meaning [b]we've now got 2 WIP minigames simultaneously[/b] for the first time in Minigame Madness history! Because of this, we've updated the look of WIP minigame thumbnails to allow you to easily distinguish them:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/6b825e786a4a1e8e0e186dfc48990c5749c63ec0.png[/img]

Furthermore, we've improved Robot Ruckus performance heavily and we believe it's sufficient now. We've also tried to fix kiting/cheesing again by making the pesky robots just a little smarter, again. We've also made them feel a little more dangerous by changing their blinking to sound more mechanical. 🤖

[b]Robot Ruckus got at least one big feature left before we're considering it finalized, stay tuned! 🧐[/b]

[h2]Improved Face Case Drops[/h2]
Face Cases too often dropped extremely mid faces like 🙂, 😐 and ☹️. We've adjusted the Face Case to drop Common faces (AKA mid faces) a bit less, therefore making Uncommon, Rare, Epic & Legendary faces drop more: 🤩🧐🥸😎🤡!

Stay tuned on all Minigame Madness news, by following us on Steam and [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]joining the Discord community[/url]!

Have an epic day, or an average one! No pressure. 👋🏼

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/25cc6ca002e2a168da4216e052b3d85783ec85cb.png[/img][h2]Bi-Weekly Update![/h2]
This update we got some requested features, tons of fixes & Robot Ruckus improvements! 🤖🤟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/99745aa64b2a5a1f632ede7a4679831348b50891.png[/img]

[h2]Spectator Freecam[/h2]
This update [b]we added a long-requested freecam mode[/b], that can be enabled by double-clicking (quickly double-tapping the Interact key) while spectating. You're free to move the freecam wherever you like! 🤩

Besides spectating whoever & whatever you like, it's also great for taking pictures and breaking the laws of physics by clipping through the ground! ☠️☠️

[h2]Improved Friends List[/h2]
It's often been difficult to find time to compare your stats with friends, because when they're online you're likely competing with them in minigames instead. 🤔

[b]Your friends' profiles are now ALWAYS visible[/b] in your friends list, no matter whether they're online or not, giving you sufficient time to analyze who's the best at shooting robots in the face! 🤖🔫

[h2]Minigame AI Training has Started![/h2]
This update and coming updates might feel a little bit smaller, as we're working towards potentially the biggest feature yet: competitive AI bots, that are at the level of human skill.

Because Minigame Madness offers so many types of genres, and will continue to expand in genres, the difficulty of programming bots manually for all minigames is simply an impossible task! 

That's why we've decided to attempt to train bots using machine-learning neural networks:

[previewyoutube=vpICFKaKj8I;full][/previewyoutube]
While they're not very intelligent yet, we hope to someday have intelligent competitive bots that can be automatically trained on whatever minigame we release!

⚠️ [I]This will be an ongoing behind-the-scenes effort. Bots are not yet in-game, and won't be for some time. It's possible that they'll never reach a state that we're happy with. It's a risky feature to develop, with potentially high reward. We'll keep you updated in our news articles![/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1408080/view/3889484725156856362]As announced last week[/url], in order to help Minigame Madness hit escape velocity on player stability, we're releasing [b]Minigame Madness Lite[/b]: the Free-2-Try version.

In order to help Minigame Madness hit escape velocity on player stability, we've been working on Minigame Madness Lite: the Free-2-Try version. [b]Lite players will be very limited in features, but are still able to play in servers with Paid players. 😄[/b]

In order to be able to offer Minigame Madness Lite in the near future, we've started work on our own in-game friends list, because Steam inviting doesn't work between different Steam games:

Baking the individual pieces into one will increase FPS on most PCs significantly, while increasing loading times slightly.
 
This is only the first step in optimizing the game. Please let us know about your experience with the new Mub rendering, especially if you had bad FPS in crowded areas before! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/e255e4cedb65bd2a4bc8e901a0256a8242021c2b.png[/img]
[h2]The first update of many![/h2]
It's been a long two weeks filled with all-nighters, hotfixes, playtesting, development, community managing, etc; But I can officially say we've survived until our very first bi-weekly update! 🤩

While we have been communicative in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]Discord community[/url], we're sorry for the radio silence on here! You can imagine the two of us have been extraordinarily busy. That said, work has paid off, and we're here with a huge update! 🤤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/13d8f3ce372e2b7adcd91e077a073ddc05b378b4.png[/img]
[h2]Upcoming Price Reduction & Player Count Talk[/h2]
Let's start with the elephant in the room.

While we fully planned for a small player base to slowly grow over time, we were surprised when almost everyone joined without bringing friends, massively increasing the need for a bigger player base. 😬

Which is why [b]we're temporarily lowering the base price from $14,99 to $9,99 starting November 27[/b], right after our launch discount ends! 🤯

We considered simply powering through the growing pains, but ultimately decided that underpricing the game in order to reach player stability sooner is the better idea. The price reduction should also make it a lot easier to bring your friends along, considering Steam won't give us a 4-pack option! 😤

The price reduction is a temporary necessity (essentially a discount) until stability is reached. To thank the supporters who joined before that, we will be giving each one of you 💎1000 & 🪙20000 on Nov 27th and [b]will PERMANENTLY stop dropping 'Founder' badges after Nov 27th[/b], making you some of the rarest Mubs in the universe! 🤩✨

[i]If you haven't purchased Minigame Madness yet, and still wish to receive the exclusive 'Founder' rewards mentioned above, [b]you have until November 27[/b] to purchase the game and register an in-game account. 

If you have less than 2 hours in Minigame Madness, you're able to refund and re-purchase the game at the lowered price. But to make it fair to the other Founders, doing so will remove your access to the exclusive 'Founder' rewards.[/i]

If you have any further questions about the temporary price reduction, don't be afraid to send us an email at info@chaoticentertainment.net or message us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]Discord[/url].

[h2]Voucher Codes[/h2]
To make it easier to invite friends, [b]we've added invitation codes to the game[/b] in form of vouchers! 

Every player now has a personalized invitation code they can share with friends, family, fans, neighbours, etc, earning you both 💎500! [b]And If you invite 3 players, you unlock the 'Promoter' badge![/b]

[b]How to claim a voucher?[/b] Simple! Press the 🛒-button in the menu, fill in the code, and press claim to receive your gems:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/63d92b8d914f195bef3f2bac10c2b5fc0a414ec7.png[/img]You can also find and copy your personal invitation code in here!

[b]Share your code with the world to get loads of gems for free! 🤑[/b] Put it in your YouTube description, your Steam/Discord bio, tattoo your dog with it, write it on your tombstone, set it as a password to your bank account and intentionally leak it — the possibilities are simply endless! 🤯 [i](for legal reasons that very last example was a joke)[/i]

⚠️[i]Steam reviews are NOT the place for sharing your codes [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/6862-8119-C23E-EA7B#:~:text=Examples%20include%3A%20advertisements%2C-,referrals,-%2C%20or%20promotions.]and it breaks community guidelines[/url].[/i]

To make things even better, [b]there's no time-limit on claiming an invitation code[/b]! This means existing players won't be left out. You ARE of course limited to only one invite claim per account, but you're not limited on sending out invites: go crazy!

Besides using vouchers for invitations, [b]we'll be putting promotional vouchers in ALL of our newsletters[/b], so make sure to subscribe when registering a Minigame Madness account! 😎

⚠️[i]While instant for invitees, it currently takes a full game restart for inviters to see their invitation rewards. We'll be making this more smooth in the future.[/i]

[h2]New WIP Minigame: Bounty Battle[/h2]
Now onto the good stuff!

While we aren't able to finalize an entire minigame with every bi-weekly update, we do understand (and share) the wish for new minigames. That's why [b]we'll be releasing Work-In-Progress (WIP) versions of our upcoming minigames[/b] from now on! 😁

[b]WIP minigames look, feel, sound & play worse than your average minigame.[/b] With every update we'll improve them, and when we're done, we'll move on to the next minigame! This will allow us to gather feedback on minigames live, and give you guys new content with each bi-weekly update. You can even follow our development live on [url=https://discord.gg/S5FT5gNbx7]Discord (#development)[/url], often with multiple posts per day.

[b]Our first ever WIP minigame Bounty Battle is playable NOW![/b] 🤯

In Bounty Battle, your goal is to eliminate the wanted criminal displayed on giant screens around the map. First, find the criminal in the horde of NPCs walking around. Once you've found the target, strike them with your stun baton! Whoever eliminates the most criminals, wins the game! 🕵️🔎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/d914889bafd76efcf2bab6af7d257322d46b3382.png[/img]
Bounty Battle gameplay feels completely different to our previous minigames, and that's intentional. [b]Our ultimate goal with Minigame Madness is to make it the "everything-game"[/b] by adding every game-genre possible! 😳

Players who have become godlike at minigames that reward movement skill (almost all previous minigames), might struggle a lot when competing in Bounty Battle, which requires perception & memorization skill instead. We want to utilize as many skills as possible, allowing all kinds of gamers to specialize in what they love most! 😍

⚠️[i]With hundreds of NPCs walking around, performance in Bounty Battle is currently real bad — we're working on it![/i]

[h2]Global Leaderboards[/h2]
The first feature to be added to the mysterious static Hub screens is global leaderboards! 🤩 

You can now show off your grind in both stats and appearance for everyone to see! That is, if you qualify to be in the top 10. 😅

The first WIP global leaderboard released is based on your level. Will you reach the top? 🫡

Sky's the limit for Minigame Madness once our servers are consistently filled, and that ONLY requires about 16 players to be online at any given moment — we'll get there! 🤟

If you want to stay tuned on all the latest Minigame Madness news, you can follow us on Steam and/or [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]join the Discord community[/url]!

Have an epic day, and don't forget to [url=https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//39683871/49bfe86426c2e7c57fac406529ed2302487e305e.png]bring friends[/url]! 👊

Minigame Madness is now finally [b]FULLY[/b] controller supported! The entire game should look a lot better now color-wise! 🤩 The lead designer of the game was working on a terrible monitor, causing all the colors in previous versions of the game to be all kinds of messed up. notes.title: 🤯 The FREE Minigame Madness demo is out NOW!
notes.content:
[b]After years of development, we're finally ready to showcase a tiny part of our big game![/b]

The demo includes three of our favorite minigames that work well solo with some stupid DemoBots. Honestly, who programmed these bots? Oh wait, we did.

[b]The three included minigames are:[/b]
[list]
[*] Disco Disorder
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/a9573c0f5907f0e7f3f9c029497a5ce5f2999b0e.png[/img]
[*] Frantic Forces
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/85d41fa7ce5a8d816ef7b1b507cccac0f80d2fb7.png[/img]
[*] Blazing Bullets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/c7de2fee8ccad337e0e3aef36b5723f27ad5a140.png[/img]
[/list]
In the full game you win when everyone else is eliminated. But since this demo is solo, you have to survive the full 2 minutes instead! How long can you survive? (We have never beaten Disco Disorder, and honestly think it's impossible. We would love to see someone prove us wrong!)

Everything in the demo is still work-in-progress, so expect bugs! We have controller support, but it's not recommended at this time. Most languages are machine-translated currently, using English instead is strongly recommended.

Don't miss out on any updates by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/ChaoticDevs]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnO9iFiOXsm1SeGpSzAVRyw]YouTube[/url]! Want to join the growing community and talk directly with the devs? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/BajtRQc]Discord[/url]!

Thanks for reading this lengthy post, and here's the trailer once again for the newcomers! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Minigame Madness Demo releases on Feb 9th! (& Updated plans for the game!)
notes.content:
[h2]Demo Release[/h2]
After years of hard work, we are so excited to finally announce that we will be bringing you the first-ever playable version of Minigame Madness in two weeks on [b]February the 9th[/b], just in time before the Steam Next Fest begins!

The free demo will be a tiny fraction of our giant game, with only three of our favorite minigames that work well in single-player (as the demo won't have multiplayer), and will be available indefinitely!

Make sure to mark [b]Feb 9th[/b] on your calendars, and if you haven't already: [b]wishlist Minigame Madness![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408080/Minigame_Madness
[h2]Storepage Rewrite[/h2]
We have recently rewritten the description of our Steam page to better reflect our plans for Minigame Madness, as they have evolved quite a bit since the description was first written! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408080/Minigame_Madness]Check it out[/url] if you want to read up on anything new and exciting!

[h2]New Playmode Plans[/h2]
One of our updated plans is to add various exciting Playmodes to the game:
[list][*][b]Arcade[/b]: Play casual minigames back-to-back!
[*][b]Royale[/b]: Be the last man standing throughout multiple minigames!
[*][b]Teams[/b]: Join forces with your friends in the minigames!
[*]Even more ideas for unique & exciting playmodes in the future.[/list] Our trailer has been updated to show the elevator which you can use to access the various Playmodes:
[previewyoutube=8YSD7VkhSsE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Join the Community![/h2]
We have a Discord server full of fun people and two crazy developers going through a mental crisis trying to deliver this demo on time. If either of those two things sound entertaining to you, make sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/BajtRQc]join our Discord server![/url]

[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39683871/34f21694df3b74d26f142ea67cbd9ffb437cd33e.png[/img]

Steam Next Fest (February 21 to 28) is an all-week event with thousands of demos to play (including ours!), countless live streams to watch, and in general to celebrate upcoming games. Don't miss it!
